title: A provider-applied 830th migration must reach the original source-lock consumer before dependent protected releases
root_cause: Protected original #5652 merged and native Supabase applied SQL version 20261112162500 exactly once, but original source migration-history.lock.json remained at 829 instead of independent provider ledger 830. This is the fourth observed producer→source-lock transfer gap today, following 827, 828 and 829 recovery.
impact: Original source truth lags live backend and later protected changes can fail preflight even though native migration was already applied and customer data not changed by source lock.
fix: Under the same original protected Supabase migration-history writer append only exact production-applied (20261112162500,original_metric_source_temporal_handoff_v1) to source lock. Preserve immutable 829 entries, source SQL and native ledger; no DDL replay, no parallel executor.
prevention_rule: The original migration producer's next protected handoff requires exact provider applied version/name + source SQL identity, source migration-history lock consumer PROCESSED readback and owner/UTC/correlation before any downstream candidate can use this epoch; fail closed without material provider evidence; persist one canonical recurrence and regression.
owner: Original protected Supabase migration history writer / ONE BRAIN backend owner
